queries.name: recent_chains
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM chains ORDER BY updated_at_us DESC, id ASC LIMIT 50

queries.name: recent_chain_events
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY created_at_us DESC, sequence DESC LIMIT 25

queries.name: chain_events
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM events WHERE chain_id = :chain_id ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 500

views.name: live_recent_chains
views.sql: SELECT * FROM chains ORDER BY updated_at_us DESC, id ASC LIMIT 50

views.name: live_recent_chain_events
views.sql: SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY created_at_us DESC, sequence DESC LIMIT 25

views.name: live_chain_events
views.sql: SELECT * FROM events WHERE chain_id = :chain_id ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 500
